title: Listen: Off the Ball with Stuart & Tam
summary: Off the Ball with Stuart & Tam is a BBC Radio football discussion show. While the program focuses on football analysis and commentary, the description suggests it employs a satirical or irreverent tone in its coverage.
content: The most petty and ill-informed football show on radio.

zh.title: 收听：Stuart与Tam的球场外对话
zh.summary: 《Stuart与Tam的球场外对话》是BBC电台的足球讨论节目。虽然该节目主要关注足球分析和评论，但其描述暗示它在报道中采用了讽刺或不敬的基调。

title: Wales hope pattern continues in Albania return
summary: Wales' women's football team secured an unconvincing victory in Albania and now seeks to build momentum with a return home in their World Cup qualification campaign. The team hopes a shift in venue will help improve their performance in this critical period.
content: After an unconvincing win in Albania, Wales hope a return home will rejuvenate their Women's World Cup bid.

zh.title: 威尔士期待在阿尔巴尼亚再战中延续胜利
zh.summary: 威尔士女子足球队在阿尔巴尼亚取得勉强胜利后，现在希望通过主场回归来建立势头，以继续世界杯预选赛之旅。该队希望主场优势能帮助他们在这个关键时期改善表现。

title: Palmer signs new Chelsea contract until 2034
summary: Cole Palmer has signed a new Chelsea contract through 2034 on improved financial terms. The deal is among the longest currently active in the Premier League, reflecting the club's strong confidence in his long-term value.
content: Cole Palmer signs a new Chelsea contract on improved terms until 2034, one of the longest active deals in the Premier League.

zh.title: 帕尔默与切尔西续约至2034年
zh.summary: 科尔·帕尔默已与切尔西签署新合同，合同期至2034年，财务条款也得到改善。该合同是英超目前最长的现役合同之一，反映了俱乐部对他长期价值的强大信心。

title: NI debut 'something I thought had passed' - Elmore
summary: Kess Elmore made her Northern Ireland debut despite a 4-0 World Cup qualifying loss to Portugal, an opportunity she thought might never come. While the defeat damaged Northern Ireland's World Cup prospects, it marked a significant personal milestone for the player.
content: Northern Ireland's World Cup hopes may have all but come to an end against Portugal, but for Kess Elmore the 4-0 defeat marks the start of a long-awaited international journey.

zh.title: NI首秀"我以为已经过去的事" - 埃尔莫尔
zh.summary: 凯丝·埃尔莫尔虽然北爱尔兰在世界杯资格赛中以0-4不敌葡萄牙,但仍然完成了国家队首秀,这是她认为可能永远不会到来的机会。虽然这场失利损害了北爱尔兰的世界杯前景,但这对这位球员来说是一个重要的个人里程碑。

title: Delight for Scotland's Cuthbert after long summer of recovery
summary: Erin Cuthbert returned to action for Scotland after recovering from a lengthy summer injury, marking her first appearance of the season in a convincing 2-0 victory over Czech Republic. Her comeback is a significant boost for both the player and Scotland's World Cup qualifying efforts.
content: Erin Cuthbert expresses joy and relief at making her first appearance of the season in Scotland's impressive 2-0 win over Czech Republic.

zh.title: 苏格兰卡斯伯特经过漫长的夏季复原后喜出望外
zh.summary: 埃琳·卡斯伯特在长期夏季伤病恢复后重返苏格兰国家队,在一场对阵捷克共和国的压倒性胜利(2-0)中首次亮相本赛季。她的复出对该球员和苏格兰的世界杯资格赛努力来说都是一个重大提升。

title: Raphinha's brilliant Barcelona start interrupted by injury concerns
summary: Raphinha's strong start at Barcelona has been interrupted by an injury sustained during the recent international break. The winger is expected to miss the club's next two matches as he recovers.
content: Raphinha will miss Barcelona's next two fixtures after returning from international break with an injury.

zh.title: 拉菲尼亚在巴塞罗那的出色开局因伤患担忧而中断
zh.summary: 拉菲尼亚在巴塞罗那的强势开局因最近国际比赛周期间遭受的伤病而中断。这位边锋预计将缺席俱乐部接下来的两场比赛,以便恢复。

title: Celtic decide against offering Bakayoko deal - gossip
summary: Celtic has declined to offer midfielder Bakayoko a contract as the club continues its transfer strategy. In related news, Derek Riordan urged patience with Hibernian's new manager amid ongoing squad changes in Scottish football.
content: Celtic elect not to offer deal to midfielder as Derek Riordan urges patience under new Hibernian boss.

zh.title: 凯尔特人决定不向巴卡约科提供合同——传言
zh.summary: 凯尔特人俱乐部拒绝向中场球员巴卡约科提供合同，因为该俱乐部继续执行其转会策略。相关消息称，德里克·里奥丹敦促球迷对希伯尼安新经理保持耐心，因为苏格兰足球中正在进行队伍变化。

title: Tottenham to fly to Marbella for training camp
summary: Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi plans to take his squad to Marbella for a team-building training camp following their upcoming match against Manchester United. The trip aims to strengthen squad cohesion and prepare the team for future challenges.
content: Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi to take his squad to Marbella for team-bonding training camp after clash against Manchester United

zh.title: 热刺飞赴马贝拉进行训练营
zh.summary: 热刺主教练罗伯托·德泽尔比计划在即将对阵曼联的比赛后，带领球队前往马贝拉进行一次建队训练营。该行程旨在加强球队的凝聚力，并为未来的挑战做准备。

title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
summary: BBC Football is offering interactive quizzes including 'Who Am I?', 'Five in Five,' and 'Brainteaser' to test fans' football knowledge. The games provide an engaging way for supporters to challenge their understanding of the sport.
content: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 我是谁？加上今天的其他测验
zh.summary: BBC足球频道提供互动测验，包括"我是谁？"、"五分钟五题"和"脑筋急转弯"，以测试球迷的足球知识。这些游戏为支持者提供了一种引人入胜的方式来挑战他们对该运动的理解。

title: Time to rise? Ranking European football's sleeping giants
summary: BBC Football examines Europe's 'sleeping giants' — historic clubs like Sampdoria, Saint-Etienne, and Real Zaragoza that have declined from former prominence. The analysis explores which of these clubs possess the potential to return to their peak status in European football.
content: From Sampdoria to Saint-Etienne and Real Zaragoza, who are the sleeping giants of European football?

zh.title: 时该崛起了?盘点欧洲足坛的沉睡巨人
zh.summary: BBC足球频道检视欧洲的"沉睡巨人"——曾经辉煌而如今衰落的历史悠久的俱乐部,如桑普多利亚、圣埃蒂安和皇家萨拉戈萨。分析探讨了这些俱乐部中哪些具有重返欧洲足坛巅峰地位的潜力。
